reviews.title: better than Nvidia for the price
reviews.comment: Bought for a build for a friend. He's been using it about 9 months now and it seems to be working just fine.
reviews.author: James Rosenthal

reviews.title: Always prepare
reviews.comment: Good, but installing it messed up a hard drive. Lost data but my fault for not backing it up.
reviews.author: Justin Du

reviews.title: Great budget card. Small bus compared to some but surprisingly good performance
reviews.comment: Replaced an ancient R9-390X 8GB card that despite being a decade old could handle almost everything 60+ fps @ 1080. Despite the 192bit bus this card performs very well. I'd really prefer a 256 but or 512 bit bus but for mostly 1080p and occasionally 1440p this card works very well for a budget card.
reviews.author: Vernon N Mullins

reviews.title: Worth it
reviews.comment: I always feel like refurbed parts are in some small sense a gamble, so I was a little hesitant to buy this card, but I’m glad I did. Couldn’t really tell it was not brand new, performs great too! Definitely worth the money.
reviews.author: Ryan
